definitions.explanation: A relatively small physical distance. Used for travel, communication, combat, and other contexts involving proximity.

examples.japanese: {近距離|きんきょり}の{通勤|つうきん}は{楽|らく}だ。
{近距離|きんきょり}から{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}った。
examples.english: I took a photo from close range.

examples.japanese: {近距離|きんきょり}の{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しなら{自分|じぶん}でできるかもしれない。
examples.english: If it's a short-distance move, you might be able to do it yourself.

notes:
{近距離|きんきょり} indicates a short or close-range distance. A compound of {近|きん} (near) + {距離|きょり} (distance). Commonly used as a modifier before nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近距離|きんきょり}{通勤|つうきん}: short-distance commute
- {近距離|きんきょり}{恋愛|れんあい}: relationship with someone nearby (vs long-distance)
- {近距離|きんきょり}{攻撃|こうげき}: close-range attack
- {近距離|きんきょり}{無線|むせん}: short-range wireless
- {近距離|きんきょり}{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し: short-distance move

CONTRAST:
- {長距離|ちょうきょり}: long distance (opposite)
- {中距離|ちゅうきょり}: medium distance
- {短距離|たんきょり}: short distance (more commonly used for races and sprints)
